name: footer-regulatory
title: Regulatory footer
description: A footer for regulated businesses: registration facts, the regulator statement, a risk notice and the legal links, set to be read.
docs: Pass the link columns, the registration rows ({ label, value }: trade register, VAT ID, licence, registered office; each value selects whole in one click), the statements ({ title, body, icon }: the regulator statement and the risk or liability notice, set in normal text and never as fine print; body may hold a link to the register entry), the complaint and dispute links, and reviewed ({ label, dateTime }) for the last time the wording was checked, which sits in a time element. brand and tagline are optional. Links that leave your site open in a new tab and say so; linkAs renders the internal ones with your router's Link, and labels translates the fixed words. No state of its own, so it renders on the server.
